description: Valid and invalid 2.2 sources outside the gate-1 corpus that use view, state, in and out in their keyword roles next to names (unquoted names starting with the words, quoted names that are the words), if statements, and single associations (WP2). Each parses with the kept 2.2 grammar. Their diagnostics, normalized ASTs and runs are recorded once from implementation 3.1.0 in recorded-wp2.json and compared by scripts/compatibility-2-2-extended.mjs.

models.name: ctx: in and out directions next to names that start with the words
ctx: state keyword next to quoted state names and a quoted state attribute
ctx: view keyword next to quoted view names and filter operands
ctx: for-each loops with quoted element names and collections
ctx: package, datatype and operation names of quoted contextual words
ctx: if statements with else blocks and parenthesized conditions
assoc: single associations with a repeat in two spellings
assoc: valid single associations with two spellings
assoc: invalid single associations: subject and other packages
assoc: duplicate single association and an unknown case
types: type errors next to if statements
susp: suspending calls in expressions and if conditions
ports: quoted contextual-word ports and members with publish, send and calls
tests: a test reads quoted contextual-word attributes
tests: on call out bindings with in and out directions
stale: stale write across waits in if branches
names: ambiguous quoted reserved word reported with its spelling
names: identifiers that start with the contextual words
